name: iringa-dating
description: Iringa Dating - location-aware dating app for Iringa city, villages and surrounding areas, Tanzania

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:mobile && npm run backend:setup
scripts.backend:setup: npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace backend && npm run prisma:seed --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm --prefix mobile run lint
